name: io.github.careycao/wechat-to-kb
title: wechat-to-kb
description: Save WeChat articles, web pages, videos (Bilibili, YouTube, TikTok, etc.) and local documents (PDF/DOCX/PPTX) to a local knowledge base with auto-routing and AI-powered categorization. Ideal for researchers, content creators, and RAG/LLM workflows.

environmentVariables.name: KB_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Root directory of the local knowledge base (default: ~/knowledge_base)

environmentVariables.name: KB_NON_INTERACTIVE
environmentVariables.description: Set to '1' to disable interactive routing prompts (required in MCP context)

environmentVariables.name: KB_HEADLESS
environmentVariables.description: Set to '1' to run Playwright browser in headless mode (recommended for server/background use)

environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional: API key for AI-powered document value assessment (import_local_file). Not required if Claude Code CLI is installed.
